name: Allow + malformed condition value (non-primitive array member)
note: IAM-1508 / S2-guard-parity regression. A Condition value array carrying a non-primitive member ([{}]) is rejected by AWS as MalformedPolicyDocument, yet conditions.js toValueArray silently DROPS the member - so the engine evaluated a value set the author did not write. The shared engine must mark coverage INCOMPLETE (MALFORMED_CONDITION_VALUE) so neither surface reports a clean/faithful pass on an undeployable, un-faithfully-modeled grant.
